candidates.requirement: Build stream_round_trip with the supported compressor exclusion options so its existing strategy selection and streaming round trip exercise the conditional strategy remapping and compressor tables.
candidates.target_route: Set ZSTD_LIB_EXCLUDE_COMPRESSORS_DFAST_AND_UP=1 or ZSTD_LIB_EXCLUDE_COMPRESSORS_GREEDY_AND_UP=1 when building stream_round_trip; supply raw input selecting an affected strategy, then call ZSTD_compressStream2.
candidates.failure_condition: Under the supplied build recipe and source defaults, both options are 0. The exclusion macros and their guarded compressor behavior are absent from the target binary for every fuzz input.
candidates.alternative_paths: The target can vary strategy, input, and stream directives, but none can define a compile-time exclusion macro after the binary is built. The supplied build path passes no nondefault exclusion option.
